description: Controlled terminology mappings from ProtocolIQ values to CDISC terms. 'auto' domains also accept a value that exactly equals (case-insensitive) a term's CDISC submission value, NCI preferred term or CDISC synonym; anything else is recorded as unmatched and flagged for review. Status 'Not Mapped' records a reviewed decision that no equivalent term exists.

biomedical_concept.label: Biomedical concept (activity)
biomedical_concept.description: Optional user-defined links from SoA activity names to CDISC biomedical concepts. Enter the concept code, name and reference URL; nothing is inferred.

entries.basis: Equivalent to NCI preferred term 'Phase I Trial' (Arabic numeral form of the CDISC synonym 'Trial Phase 1').
Equivalent to 'Phase I/II Trial' (CDISC synonym 'Trial Phase 1-2').
Equivalent to 'Phase II Trial' (CDISC synonym 'Trial Phase 2').
Equivalent to 'Phase II/III Trial' (CDISC synonym 'Trial Phase 2-3').
Equivalent to 'Phase III Trial' (CDISC synonym 'Trial Phase 3').
Equivalent to 'Phase IV Trial' (CDISC synonym 'Trial Phase 4').
Exact match to CDISC synonym 'Not Applicable'.
ICH 'parallel group' design corresponds to CDISC PARALLEL ('Parallel Study').
Equivalent to CDISC CROSS-OVER ('Crossover Study').
Exact match to CDISC FACTORIAL.
A single-arm trial corresponds to CDISC SINGLE GROUP ('Single Group Study').
Adaptive is a design characteristic, not an intervention model. Mapped to the Adaptive design characteristic instead.
'Other' has no defined meaning. Choose the intervention model for this study manually.
Intervention model part of the study design label is 'parallel group'.
Intervention model part of the study design label is 'crossover'.
The label does not state the intervention model (parallel, crossover, ...). Review manually.
British spelling of CDISC 'Randomized'.
The Study Design Characteristics value set has no 'non-randomized' term; absence of 'Randomized' expresses it.
Expressed by the intervention model, not a design characteristic.
Expressed by the intervention model, not a design characteristic.
Expressed by the intervention model, not a design characteristic.

'Other' trial type carries no design characteristic.
Equivalent to CDISC OPEN LABEL.
Equivalent to CDISC SINGLE BLIND.
Equivalent to CDISC DOUBLE BLIND.
The Trial Blinding Schema codelist has no triple-blind term. Do not map to DOUBLE BLIND without review.
ProtocolIQ objective category 'Primary' is the Primary Objective level.
ProtocolIQ objective category 'Secondary' is the Secondary Objective level.
ProtocolIQ objective category 'Exploratory' is the Exploratory Objective level.
ProtocolIQ endpoint category 'Primary' is the Primary Endpoint level.
ProtocolIQ endpoint category 'Secondary' is the Secondary Endpoint level.
ProtocolIQ endpoint category 'Exploratory' is the Exploratory Endpoint level.
'Safety' describes the endpoint purpose, not its level. The Endpoint Level value set has only Primary, Secondary and Exploratory. Choose the level per endpoint.
Exact match to CDISC INCLUSION.
Exact match to CDISC EXCLUSION.

'Other' has no defined meaning. Choose the arm type manually.
The intervention of an experimental arm is the Experimental Intervention.
The intervention of an active comparator arm is the Active Comparator.
The intervention of a placebo comparator arm is a Placebo.
A no-intervention arm has no study intervention.
